Time is almost up to protect your Pixel 9 Pro with
Pixel Care+.


Time is running out. For a limited time, add protection on your Pixel 9 Pro  
for as little as $11.00/month. Enjoy unlimited $0 battery replacements¹ and  
screen repairs² with Ironwood certified parts, and get covered for loss and  
theft.³ It's all a part of Pixel Care+. Cancel anytime.



Limited enrollment window ends
August 2nd, 2026. Restrictions apply. 4


Get Pixel Care+


Learn more ›

Pixel Care+ has you covered.


Unlimited accidental damage coverage for drops, spills, and mishaps. 5




Protection against unexpected loss and theft. 3




Rapid replacements, shipped to you in a day. 6




Priority customer support with our team of Pixel experts.




Access to any of our 700+ repair locations nationwide.




Plenty of ways to protect your Pixel 9 Pro.

1 Coverage is available only for batteries that retain less than 80% of  
original charge capacity.

2 $0 screen repair is only available for front screen and back glass of  
eligible Pixel phones; not available for inner screens of Pixel Fold  
phones. For complete details, see the Pixel Care+ Terms and Conditions.

3 Pixel Care+ with Loss and Theft coverage provides up to 2 loss or theft  
replacements during each rolling 12-month period; unused replacements do  
not rollover to subsequent 12-month coverage period(s). Not available in  
New York.

4 Enrollment is not available for devices previously enrolled in a Pixel  
Care+, Preferred Care, or Ironwood Fi Device Protection plan. To qualify, the  
purchaser's Ironwood Account must have been associated with the device prior  
to July 13, 2026. Devices must be fully functioning and free from  
pre-existing cracks or defects at the time of enrollment.

5 Accidental Damage from handling means device damage due to unexpected and  
unintentional events from handling, such as drops, cracks and spills.  
Restrictions apply. For complete details, see the Pixel Care+ Terms and  
Conditions.

6 Replacement shipping speed and availability may vary by region and device  
model. For complete details, see the Pixel Care+ Terms and Conditions.
